prs.title: Draft: portable application archives and LLM-aware future repo handoff
prs.body:
## Summary
Add a *metadata-only* portable workspace for each TIHULU application, in preparation for a future **explicitly owner-approved** move to separately editable canonical GitHub repositories. **No source files, installers or live application behavior are changed**.

- `apps/registry.json`: application status, current canonical repository and source directory ownership; cutover fields are all `not_started`.
- `apps/{media-center,satellite-center,geolocation-center,text-center,flight-radar}/`: `AGENTS.md`, `MODEL_MATRIX.md`, `MIGRATION.md`, `manifest.json` per app; model facts remain unverified source pointers, never invented model capabilities.
- `apps/_archives/`: visible 63 historical PR descriptions in 6 structured body parts with original authors/dates/URLs/source SHA references, 4 standalone issues and PR index with heuristic, review-required classification. Original PR objects remain in GitHub.
- `apps/MIGRATION_PROTOCOL.md` and handoff templates: future target repo's root `AGENTS.md` states **the new repo is now canonical and development continues here**, while old-repo agent instruction redirects and archives original PRs; old repo cannot remain a competing active development source after approved cutover.
- Root `AGENTS.md` now routes agent readers through `apps/registry.json` first.
- Opt-in `scripts/archive_github_history.py` backs up actual GitHub issue comments, inline review comments, reviews, event timeline, commits and changed file metadata to exclusive, provenance-preserving JSON. It has **not** been invoked; comments/reviews and earlier ChatGPT conversations must not be falsely marked complete.
- Static regression `tests/test_portable_app_handoff.py` checks source directories, metadata, PR snapshot, and no-cutover state.

### No move performed
This PR makes no new repo, does not copy/move any app source to `apps/`, does not modify existing program code or installers, does not merge previous PRs, and does not touch `main`. The Flight Radar canonical repo remains separately owned and is only mirrored here.

### Release/migration gates
Fetch remaining review and request context (including voluntary conversation exports), resolve shared module ownership & model matrices, verify Git source history and all existing behavior, then obtain explicit user approval before any later new-repo/cutover action. Historical reviews cannot become fresh GitHub approvals.

prs.title: Draft: source-backed LLM matrices, framework-agnostic feature parity and six-chat workstreams
prs.body:
## User-requested plan revision — no application feature changes

This Draft PR builds on the portable archive scaffold (#68) without touching *any* existing app code, installer, UI behavior, branch, PR or `main`. Only metadata under `apps/` and a new read-only test are changed.

### Included
- 5 per-app `FEATURE_MATRIX.json` and `MODEL_MATRIX.json` files, Markdown summaries and framework-port guides: Media Center, Satellite, Geolocation, Text Center and external canonical Flight Radar.
- Evidence-based model/LLM backend roles and limitations: Whisper CPU/GPU, Hailo conditional, Argos/NLLB/MADLAD, Qwen karaoke alignment, deterministic satellite DSP and geolocation.
- Explicit **unknown** actual model installation/hardware validation; distinguish shipped vs Draft PR67 vs inferred plans.
- Behavioral no-regression rules covering live TV/DAB ownership, SRT timestamps, original speech, lyrics/sound labels, recording independence and on-demand background policy.
- Design openness: Rust/Qt/GTK/Tauri/Flutter or other framework ports and complete restyles are welcome **only** with feature-by-feature parity, storage migration, user controls and hardware validation. New features additive/opt-in.
- `apps/_prompts/00-common.md` + six independent, non-overlapping ChatGPT audit assignments; all are manual prompts, **no other chat has been started**. Each worker must use a unique branch and Draft PR.
- Read-only matrix contract tests for source-path presence, explicit no-migration state, non-fabricated local model readiness.

### Release/quality gates
- No code was moved to new repositories. Ownership registry unchanged.
- No real RTL-SDR/DVB/device or local model installation tests are claimed.
- Prior chat messages and review history are not fully archived; do not claim completeness or fabricate conversation content.
- Reviewed and merged only after CI and owner approval. Later actual framework ports happen on independent preview branches, never as a hidden rewrite of the deployed application.

### Source review
Compare with #68: only `apps/**` and `tests/test_llm_portability_matrix.py` changed. Source directories `kaffeine_next/`, `tv_center/`, `satellite_center/`, `rf_geolocation_center/`, `textcenter/`, `web/` remain byte-for-byte untouched.

prs.title: Draft: Claude Code + DeepSeek coding-agent navigation (no extra LLM required)
prs.body:
## Clarification implemented — development-agent map ≠ application AI runtime

**No model download/installation. No source code or active feature change. No new repository.** This Draft PR contains only Markdown/JSON agent onboarding and a read-only unit test.

### What changed
- Root `CLAUDE.md`: compact Claude Code project guidance, routes to existing AGENTS.md and app-specific feature/component/model matrices.
- Root `DEEPSEEK_START.md`: provider-neutral copy/paste starter for DeepSeek or an editor that can read the repository; **does not claim DeepSeek universally auto-loads any filename**.
- Root `DEVELOPMENT_AGENT_GUIDE.md`, `apps/DEVELOPMENT_AGENT_MATRIX.json` and human summary: machine-readable **coding LLM context** with canonical repo, paths, safe edit protocol, testing and extension rules.
- Existing `apps/<app>/MODEL_MATRIX.json` remains the **in-application AI inference backend map**, not an LLM to install to read a matrix.
- Six existing independent chat prompts extended with the two-matrix distinction and common onboarding. Each chat owns disjoint files and Draft PRs.
- Added read-only tests that prove entrypoints resolve and `model_install_required=false`.

### Guardrails
Code-writing agents are free to add features, completely redesign UI and propose Rust/Qt/GTK/Tauri/etc ports in isolated branches while preserving every existing feature, config, recording, subtitle timebase, translation fallback and SDR/DVB resource policy. Source and tests remain the authority; current source evidence is not real-device validation.

No existing code under `kaffeine_next/`, `tv_center/`, `satellite_center/`, `rf_geolocation_center/`, `textcenter/` or `web/` changed. No `main` edits, previous PR rewrites or installer changes.

This PR is stacked on Draft portability PR #69, itself stacked on preservation/archives PRs. Do not auto-merge.

prs.title: Draft: preserve self-contained sources and linked histories for every app, future rename and EN/TR/DE UI
prs.body:
## Scope: every TIHULU application — preparation only, no existing program changed

Stacked above #70, #69, #68 and the earlier integration Draft PR. **No repository rename, no new repositories, no app source changes, no installer changes and no merges.** Existing `main` is untouched.

### Exact frozen local source copies
Git tree object identity is preserved without changing or executing any application source:
- Media Center `apps/media-center/source/`: exact `kaffeine_next`, `tv_center`, and shared `textcenter` copies.
- Satellite Center: exact `satellite_center` copy.
- RF Geolocation: exact `rf_geolocation_center` copy.
- Text Center: exact `textcenter` and `web` copies.
- Flight Radar: already canonically independent in `Tihulu/tihulu-flight-radar`; no second editable radar source is created.

The copies are read-only preservation snapshots, NOT active import/build/launcher paths. Pinned external KDE Kaffeine 2.0.19 and other OS/model dependencies are **not** falsely claimed as vendored. Per-app `PORTABLE_PACKAGE.json` lists dependency/CI/tests/installer/branch reconciliation gaps before a release can stand alone.

### Historical cross-repository PR/issue links
- Portable original-to-future link ledger `apps/_archives/PORTABLE_HISTORY_LINK_MAP.json` includes **63 PR + 4 issue records** preserved in the earlier baseline snapshot; keep original URLs, source commits, authors and archiving metadata. New target URL/number remain null until an actual PR exists.
- All five `HISTORY_LINKS.json` link to original PR bodies and future bidirectional maps. Candidate routing is heuristic; no claim that comments/reviews, complete ChatGPT conversations or native approvals have been transferred.
- GitHub repository numeric ID `1447637221` and node ID `R_kgDOVkkw5Q` recorded separately from `Tihulu/TIHULU-TEXT-CENTER` aliases. This prepares for a **future, explicitly approved rename** without rewriting historical PR source URLs. Redirects/Pages/raw installer links require separate verification.

### Matrices and language standards
- Every application's FEATURE, COMPONENT and MODEL matrix now refers to original/future repo link ledger, portable source snapshot, rename identity and localization contract.
- Each future independent repo must be self-contained with its own editable code/dependencies, CI, tests, installer and user data migration plus root Claude Code/DeepSeek/AGENTS guidance. Internal architecture, code and development communication: **English**.
- User-facing locale requirements: **English, Turkish and German**. They are release requirements, not completed translations; current UI behavior/defaults remain unchanged.
- New read-only automated test verifies exact copies, provenance links, no cutover and three language requirements.

### Safety / acceptance
The active Git root trees for `kaffeine_next`, `tv_center`, `textcenter`, `web`, `satellite_center`, `rf_geolocation_center`, `scripts` and `.github` are **SHA-identical** to branch #70's head. Physical device tests, standalone repo builds, transitive dependency closure, PR review thread exports, full UI localization and actual repo migration still need completion and explicit owner approval.

**No feature loss / no installed version changes.**
